Welcome To
Rangachahi College, Majuli
NAAC Accredited, Under Dibrugarh University, Established 1983
Rangachahi College is a rural higher educational institution that leads the higher education in the Majuli of Majuli district, Assam. It was set up in 1983 affiliated under the Dibrugarh University. The college is situated eastward about 10 Kilometres away from the Garamur, headquarter of the Majuli Sub-division.

For more details, please call +91 7086748383 - +919864156769 or at office during office hour.
SEMINAR
We are inviting research papers for the two-day National Seminar to be held from 19th to 20th March, 2026, on “Next Generation GST Reforms and Socio-Economic Transformation in North East India,” organised in collaboration with the Indian Council of Social Science Research.
Original and unpublished research papers from academicians, researchers, and students across the country are cordially invited.
For more details, please refer to the brochure link attached herewith or visit our college website, go to the Download section, and open the seminar link.

Admission Notice
Online Admission for the 2025-2026 Session for Higher Secondary (Darpan Admission Portal, Link - https://darpan.ahseconline.in/)  Arts Stream is going on. For more details, please call +91 7086748383 - +919864156769 or at office during office hour.
ADMISSION FEE REFUND NOTICE
This is to inform all students (Newly Admitted B.A. 1st Semester,   H.S. 1st and 2nd Year) that the amount of Rs. 650/- collected will be refunded starting from 15-07-2024.
To receive your refund, you are directed to submit your original receipt (the receipt collected during admission time) at the account office.  The refund process will be handling during office hours from 10.00 AM to 4.00 PM.
SPOT ADMISSION NOTICE
In pursuance of notification Ecf No: 473870/21 Dated: Kahilipara, 21st June, 2024 and guideline for Spot Admission 27th June, 2024, it is general information to all concerned students who wish to take admission in B.A. 1st semester and have not secured admission in the last two rounds of admission and also to those who have not yet registered on the Assam State Higher Education Admission Portal (https://assamadmission.samarth.ac.in) that they can contact the undersigned for Spot Admission starting from 29th June, 2024 to 1st July, 2024 at Rangachahi College, Majuli during office hours.

Registration of New Voters
It is an information for all New Voters consisting the age group fron 17 to 21 that they can get themselves registred as New Voters with the help of the prescribed links given. The applicant can use this link of application form for being a New Voter.
1. https://www.nvsp.in
2. https://voters.eci.gov.in
3. Required Documents: AADHAR Card/Pan Card/ HSLC Admit Card/Birth Certificate (For age proof)
4. AADHAR Card/Bank Passbook/Ration Card (For address proof)
5. Passport size photograph

Facilities At A Glance...
We wholeheartedly extend our warm wishes to your deep aspiring step in pursuit of academic career. To choose the destination where to get admitted for further studies is nor always an easy decision. But if you are willing to devote for humanities, social devedlopment and personal upliftment, we can assure you that Rangachahi College is at present scenerio, one of the best centre of knowledge. The college is able to produce top rank holders in B.A. final examinations under Dibrugarh University in Arts Stream. We have introduced Major Courses in Political Science, Sociology, Economics, History, Education along with compulsory subjects of Assamese and English in Arts streams and Physics, Chemistry, Botany, Mathematics, Statistics, Zoology, Geology and Geography in Science stream(Non-Major).
We have also introduced Distance Education in both M.A. and B.A. courses under Dibrugarh University. In M.A. also, the college is able to produce top rank holders in final examinations under Dibrugarh University. We have a brilliant set of dedicated faculties sustaining an intimated and friendly relationship among the teachers and students as well.

Dear Students and Parents,
I earnestly appeal you to all “Come with White and Go with Green”. The Rangachahi College is rural educational leader that impart quality education. Quest for knowledge is its task of the ever best. Knowledge is omnipresent irrespective of rural, urban, state, country and the continent.
